title: Best practices for naming Java packages
answer: Use lowercase package names and a stable reverse-domain-style root when an organization owns a domain, then add meaningful subpackages that reflect architecture or domain responsibility. Avoid uppercase letters, spaces, Java keywords, unstable team names, and vague catch-all names. AeroTopo uses `com.aerotopo` as its root and separates areas such as `domain`, `service`, `config`, `persistence`, `gis`, and `learning`, which keeps names predictable and reduces collisions.
